claim: arch_map_command.md:42 still says of `spex map list`, "Exit code 0. Empty array `[]` if the journal is absent or holds no task-bearing events," and arch_map_command.md:12 caps the whole command tree at "Set exit codes: 0 for success, 1 for errors." Both statements are the pre-lifecycle behaviour that test_map_command.md's "No journal exists" edge case (line 58) retired: that leaf now requires the lifecycle pre-flight to refuse before the store is consulted, naming `spex init` with the not-a-spex-project exit code (3) when no project state exists at all, and naming `spex doctor` when a snapshot exists but the journal does not.
authoritative_source: spec/map/test_map_command.md:58, "No journal exists": "the lifecycle pre-flight refuses before the store is consulted ... the error names `spex init` with the not-a-spex-project exit code ... In no case is any file created by a read-only command. The old empty-array answer survives only at the MappingStore library layer, which still folds an absent file to empty." This is the more recently authored statement (rewritten by e98a34f, the project-lifecycle proposal) and is what this PR's code implements.
evidence: `git show e98a34f --stat -- spec/map/` touches only arch_map_command.md's File Location paragraph (lines 83-86) and test_map_command.md's edge case (line 58); it left arch_map_command.md's Subcommands section (line 42, `spex map list`'s own exit-code prose) and its Responsibilities section (line 12, the command-wide "0 for success, 1 for errors" cap) untouched. This PR's `cmd/spex/map.go` (`mapPreflight`, wired into all three children) ships the refusal test_map_command.md:58 requires — including the `exitNotAProject` (3) exit code — which now contradicts arch_map_command.md:12 and :42 verbatim. The two leaves of this one bead disagree about behaviour this PR ships; reconciling which wins belongs to the authoring loop, not to a silent implementer choice.
proposed_fix: Reword arch_map_command.md:42 to describe the lifecycle pre-flight refusal (a broken project names `spex doctor`; no project state at all names `spex init` and exits with the not-a-spex-project code) in place of "Exit code 0. Empty array `[]` if the journal is absent or holds no task-bearing events." Reword arch_map_command.md:12's "Set exit codes: 0 for success, 1 for errors" to acknowledge the third, not-a-spex-project exit code the pre-flight can return, mirroring how arch_diff_command.md documents DiffCommand's own exit codes for the same seam.
